statements.subject: server
statements.description: This command asks the receiver to confirm that the argument identifies a user or mailbox. This command has no effect on the reverse-path buffer, the forward-path buffer, or the mail data buffer.
statements.post_cond: session.reverse_path_buffer.unchanged = true & session.forward_path_buffer.unchanged = true & session.mail_data_buffer.unchanged = true
actions: return user or mailbox confirmation information

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: This command has no effect on the reverse-path buffer, the forward-path buffer, or the mail data buffer.
statements.guard_semantics: VRFY must not modify reverse_path_buffer, forward_path_buffer, or mail_data_buffer
